project.reason: This command does not evaluate a project. Resolve project context with an explicit inspect or build operation.

contracts.name: DiagnosticCodes
contracts.description: Diagnostic codes and source positions from T01. Codes keep their meaning in 1.x.

contracts.name: JsonEnvelopes
contracts.description: Machine-readable CLI envelopes and exit codes from T04. Fields grow additively.

contracts.name: Inspection
contracts.description: Document snapshots, workspace lifetime, front matter schemas and navigation from T02, T03 and T07, T08.

contracts.name: DevServer
contracts.description: Machine control events with startup, rebuild and shutdown from T05. Event types grow additively.

contracts.name: MigrationReport
contracts.description: Migration verdicts, aggregates and fix candidates from T09. Fingerprint rules stay stable.

capabilities.name: document-inspection
capabilities.description: Unsaved document inspection. The syntax and front matter stages run without a project; project-resolution, generated-output and runtime stages require an explicit project operation.

capabilities.name: versioned-snapshot
capabilities.description: Inspection snapshots carry the document version and project generation so stale results are discarded instead of published.

capabilities.name: serve-shutdown
capabilities.description: Structured shutdown over stdin for the development server. Duplicate, in-flight and mid-startup shutdown requests are idempotent.

capabilities.name: source-route-lookup
capabilities.description: Source to route lookup that keeps project, collection and variant identity and returns every candidate route instead of guessing one.
